description: This file contains partial class definitions related to Azure Table Grain Directory options and implementation within the Orleans distributed framework. It defines configuration options, validators, and the core AzureTableGrainDirectory class that manages grain directory entries using Azure Tables.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Table Grain Directory, inheriting from AzureStorageOperationOptions, including a default table name.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AzureTableGrainDirectoryOptions, inheriting from AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Base class providing configuration options for Azure Storage operations, including client options, table name, and other connection settings.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator`1
classes.description: Generic validator class for AzureStorageOperationOptions, implements IConfigurationValidator.

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Configuration for operation retries, timeouts, and other policies.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectory
classes.description: Core class implementing IGrainDirectory, managing grain address registration, lookup, and unregistration using Azure Tables; participates in silo lifecycle.

methods.name: AzureTableGrainDirectoryOptions
methods.description: Constructor, sets default table name constant.

methods.name: AzureTableGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor, initializes validator with options and name.

methods.name: ConfigureTableServiceClient
methods.description: Obsolete method overloads to configure TableServiceClient directly via various parameters.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the provided storage operation options.

methods.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
methods.description: Properties to set timeout and retry policies.

methods.name: AzureTableGrainDirectory
methods.description: Constructor to initialize directory with options, cluster config, and logger factory. Methods for lifecycle participation, initialization, lookup, registration, and unregistration.

methods.name: InitializeIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes the directory if not already initialized.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Lookup a grain address by grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a new grain address, optionally replacing a previous address.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Unregister all addresses associated with specified silo addresses.
